description: The resolver imports causes, institutions, agents, consequences, truth conditions, or inferred intentions and classifies the enlarged world instead of the locked completed unit.
The resolver classifies generic facts about sentence construction, such as treating every finished sentence as Settlement or multiword contribution as Distributed.
A salient semantic feature such as negation, effect, relation, or plurality swallows the coordinate and prevents Dimensional Conjunction.
A model asked to measure begins redesigning the theory, explaining philosophy, or speculating instead of preserving its assigned epistemic role.
